description: This file defines a PHP class PaymentMethod within the Opencart\-Catalog\-Model\-Checkout namespace. The class extends the Controller class from the Opencart system and provides methods to retrieve available payment methods for a checkout process. It interacts with extension models to gather and filter payment method data based on configuration and accessibility, returning a sorted list of payment method information.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A class that provides payment method retrieval functionality during checkout, extending the base Controller class and interacting with extension models to collect available payment options.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all available payment methods applicable to the given payment address, filtering by extension status and callable methods, and returns a sorted list based on their sort order.
